risk_factors.heading: Our business may be adversely affected by costs relating to product defects, and we could be faced with product liability and warranty claims.
risk_factors.quote: We make highly complex electronic components which in many cases are enabled by software and, accordingly, there is a risk that defects may occur in any of our products.

risk_factors.heading: We face risks related to security vulnerabilities in our products.
risk_factors.quote: We and third parties regularly identify security vulnerabilities with respect to our products and services.

risk_factors.heading: Security vulnerabilities and any limitations of, or adverse effects resulting from, mitigation techniques can adversely affect our results of operations, financial condition, sales, branding, customer relationships, share price, prospects, and reputation in a number of ways, any of which may be material.
risk_factors.quote: Adverse publicity about security vulnerabilities or mitigations could damage our reputation with customers or users and reduce demand for our products and services.

risk_factors.heading: Our business has suffered, and could in the future suffer, from manufacturing problems.
risk_factors.quote: Difficulties in the production process can reduce yields or interrupt production, and, as a result of such problems, we may on occasion not be able to deliver products

risk_factors.heading: We rely on the timely supply of equipment and materials and could suffer if suppliers fail to meet their delivery obligations or raise prices. Certain equipment and materials needed in our manufacturing operations are only available from a limited number of suppliers.
risk_factors.quote: Because the equipment that we purchase is complex, it is frequently difficult or impossible for us to substitute one piece of equipment for another or replace one type of material with another.

risk_factors.heading: Failure of our third party suppliers to perform could adversely affect our results of operations.
risk_factors.quote: We currently use outside suppliers for a portion of our manufacturing capacity. Outsourcing our production presents a number of risks.
